verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools through LathamDrive, including a legal document generator, the Automated Convertible Note and the Book of Jargon glossary app, so asking about a built-in AI assistant is fair for this product. However, no evidence shows any AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. Template-based document generators and a searchable glossary are related features, not an agentic AI assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
